t: A powerful 12-core Arm board built for local AI and desktop work.
steps: Buy the board from the official Orange Pi store on AliExpress. US marketplace listings run near 450 US dollars.
Get the kit cooler, a 100 W USB-C power supply, and an NVMe SSD or microSD card.
Download the Debian or Ubuntu image from the Orange Pi support page.
Update the board firmware from a USB stick as the user manual shows.
Write the image to your drive and boot to the desktop.
Open a terminal and run a Python hello world.
Try the NPU examples in the Orange Pi user manual next.
meta: Open Board. From $448. A few stores.
